name: F2M2222-0202 (Hubble)
blurb: F2M2222-0202, a dust-reddened quasar, seen by Hubble.
label: f2m22220202-hubble
story: Behind a veil of dust, a fiercely bright quasar shines from the heart of its host galaxy. Hubble imaged it to test whether merging galaxies are what switch on the most luminous quasars.

claims.text: F2M2222-0202 is one of the F2M red quasars imaged by Hubble
F2M red quasars are dust-reddened and the most intrinsically luminous quasars
The program tested whether mergers drive black hole and galaxy co-evolution
